description: Edits a text file inside the allowed folders with write access.
action replace (the default) swaps text old for new (old must match once, or set all;
differences in spacing, quotes or dashes are evened out, and if old is not found the closest
lines are shown, numbered, to copy from);
lines replaces lines start..end with new (empty new deletes them;
take the numbers from cat -n in the shell);
insert puts new after line (0 = top), or after or before the line holding the given text;
write creates or overwrites the whole file with new.
action hex only reads: it shows length bytes of any file (binary too) from offset
as a hex dump, needing only read access.
Cannot change read-only folders, the tools or context folders, or .git folders.

params.name: path
params.description: File to edit (or to show with hex), starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump/src/main.c

params.name: action
params.description: replace (default), lines, insert, write, or hex (read only)

params.name: old
params.description: replace: the exact text to replace, including indentation; include enough lines to make it unique

params.name: new
params.description: The new text: the replacement, the lines to put in, or the whole file for write

params.name: all
params.description: replace: change every occurrence of old instead of requiring exactly one

params.name: end
params.description: lines: last line to replace (default: start)

params.name: line
params.description: insert: the line to insert after; 0 inserts at the top

params.name: after
params.description: insert: instead of line, text of the line to insert after, e.g. a heading such as ## Layout (it must be on one line only)

params.name: before
params.description: insert: instead of line, text of the line to insert before

params.name: offset
params.description: hex: the first byte to show (default 0); negative counts from the end, e.g. -64 for the last 64 bytes

params.name: length
params.description: hex: how many bytes to show (default 256, at most 4096)
